text:
Nina: heads-up  we have to reconcile keyword set for webinar + two launch posts. Want to avoid cannibalization with the benchmark blog. Can we map primary/secondary keywords and priority pages?
Omar: I'll run a quick SERP gap vs last year's benchmark article and share top 10 intent keywords.
Priya: for launch posts: audience-focused headlines (dev platforms vs infra teams). Suggest so:
- "How We Measure LLM Inference: Cost & Latency Benchmarks" (informational)
- "Deploying Predictable LLM Inference at Scale" (commercial intent)

Priya: also note schema differences: launch posts -> Article schema + breadcrumbList; webinar landing -> Event + FAQ.
Jesse: internal linking matrix proposal: 1) put canonical blog link in product docs intro, 2) create an "Upcoming webinars" block on /resources listing the webinar with schema, 3) add a cross-link from the launch post to benchmark blog (rel="sponsored"? no, use regular link).
Omar: SERP gap top queries summary: ["inference benchmarks", "llm latency comparison", "open model inference cost", "deploying inference at scale", "batching LLM requests"]
Nina: prioritize keyword buckets: primary= ["inference benchmarks","llm latency"], secondary=["inference cost","batching requests","kv cache"]. Avoid using exact primary across two posts in meta title.
Priya: meta title guidance: keep <= 60 chars, include primary but differentiate by intent. Example titles: 
- Benchmarks: "LLM Inference Benchmarks 2026 — Cost & Latency | Redwood"
- Launch: "Predictable LLM Inference for Product Teams | Redwood"

Priya: redirect plan: migrate old blog paths to new canonical using 301. Keep breadcrumbs updated. Add hreflang? not for this release.
seo-bot: quick-check: test sitemap includes /webinar/inference-benchmarks-2026 and both launch posts. Missing: canonical meta on draft launch post /blog/draft-deploy-inference.html
Jesse: action items: Omar provides keyword CSV by Thu, Priya finalizes meta by Fri, Nina will own redirect CSV and verify post-launch.
Nina: timeline noted. tagging: @Omar (keywords), @Priya (meta & schema), @Jesse (internal links), @seo-bot for staging checks. :rocket:
